Jeu d'escalade : un mineur grimpe une ch: Climbing game: a miner climbs a volcano chimney by jumping from one wall to the other. Hold to charge the jump (the longer you hold, the higher it goes, and the path is shown), release to jump. Avoid the fangs stuck in the walls and the saws moving back and forth, pick up gems, and climb faster than the lava. Height, gems and record. Gem shop (ice axe, boots, helmet), three scenery levels (rock, crystals, the volcano's mouth under the stars), gamepad, fullscreen.
Maintiens Espace (ou le clic, ou A à la: Hold Space (or the click, or A on a gamepad) to charge, release to jump · P: pause
Plus tu maintiens, plus le saut monte :: The longer you hold, the higher the jump: the white dots show where you will land. A short jump goes down, handy to pass under a saw. Avoid the fangs stuck in the walls (marked by a red streak) and pick up the gems: you spend them in the shop. The lava rises faster and faster. Higher up, the rock gives way to crystals (100 m), then to the volcano's mouth under the stars (250 m).
Une fois par ascension : en pleine chute: Once per climb: while falling, press to drive the ice axe into the nearest wall and hang on.
Une fois par ascension : un croc ne te t: Once per climb: a fang does not kill you, the helmet breaks instead.
Rien n'est synchronisé : tes records res: Nothing is synced: your records stay on this device.
